evals.prompt: set up kei for me in opencode. my opencode config lives in ~/dotfiles/opencode and I already have some skills there i don't want clobbered
evals.expected_output: Clones HaikeiLabs/skills, links skill folders into the OpenCode skills dir without overwriting existing ones, verifies discovery, then pairs with a runtime (kei login first) and checks a denial.
expectations: The response installs from https://github.com/HaikeiLabs/skills, not another skills repository.
The response skips or asks about same-named existing skills instead of overwriting them.
The response includes a way to verify OpenCode discovered the skills.
The response routes the runtime half through kei login and runtime setup rather than skipping auth.

evals.prompt: We use Claude Code and Codex on the team. How do we get the Haikei skills into both and make sure tool calls actually go through Kei?
evals.expected_output: Gives the plugin marketplace commands for both, explains skills do not grant permission, and wires kei-proxy authorize with agent identity and a denial test.
expectations: The response gives the Claude Code and Codex plugin marketplace commands for HaikeiLabs/skills.
The response states installing skills does not by itself allow tool calls; policy decides.
The response includes a deny check where an unbound call must fail.

evals.prompt: Can I hook up Windsurf to Kei the same way?
evals.expected_output: Says Windsurf is not a supported harness; unsupported harnesses are denied until an adapter is registered.
expectations: The response does not claim Windsurf is supported.
The response lists the supported local adapters.
